Raw archive goes to approved artifact bucket; immutable CAS manifest only after successful matching readback.
hypotheses: Equal-degree tail splitting enables Brent-Kung rather than generic FLINT Horner fallback and may reduce complete norm cost at larger B; native overhead may erase the gain at small B.
Fixed-window batched label multiplication may reduce full relation cost; Straus and unchanged frozen-pair controls distinguish arithmetic/backend changes from batching.
Bloom filtering may reduce exact hashmap probes but its hashing/setup may cost more; retain both arms and A/A noise control.
